title: DAC12 FIFO 定时器触发
description: DAC12 sends a sawtooth signal using a hardware timer trigger. The timer trigger is configured to 32768Hz/1/32 = 1024Hz. The output frequency of the sawtooth signal will be 1024 / (Number of samples).
